params.body: ## Why The Elixir measurement of 2026-11-11 found three problems on https://stockcars.be: - **1 of 5 pages broken (PAGES_BROKEN).** robots.txt names `https://stockcars.be/sitemap-index.xml/`. A sitemap name with a trailing slash is unusual, and `/sitemap-index.xml` without the slash answers **404** on the live site. The comment in `netlify.toml` says "the adapter serves both forms", but it does not. With no sitemap to read, the crawl starts at the home page and normalises links without their slash. `/over-ons`, `/services` and `/gegevensbescherming` are static and Netlify redirects them with a 301. **`/aanbod` answers 404.** It is the page behind "Wagens" in the menu, and it renders per request, so Netlify has no file to redirect from. With `trailingSlash: 'always'`, Astro does not match the path either. The same 404 applies to `/aanbod/` without the slash. I reproduced it by calling the built SSR handler directly: `404 /aanbod`, `404 /sitemap-index.xml`, `200 /aanbod/`. - **Basic tags 83/100 (SEO_WEAK).** The four pages that answered all have a title, a meta description, one h1, a canonical, an og:image and no noindex. All 37 URLs in the sitemap have them too, and no `` is missing its `alt`. The score is 25 of 30 points, and the 5 missing points belong to the 404 page. Fixing the 404 is the fix for the tags. - **LCP 4.8 s, score 81 (LCP_POOR).** Lighthouse mobile names the LCP element: `header#masthead > picture > img.hero-img`, loading `gevel-mobiel.webp` (1100×1774, 165 kB). It is already preloaded with `fetchpriority=high`, eager, and in WebP, so discovery is not the problem. The problem is bytes. The emulated phone shows about 890 device pixels of it, and in the same window the four Inter weights load: 58 to 67 kB each, 258 kB in total, because the files carry Greek, Cyrillic and Vietnamese too. A Netlify rule `/aanbod -> /aanbod/` would not help. Netlify ignores the trailing slash when it matches rules, so the rule redirects to itself. The comment in `netlify.toml` records the same loop for the sitemap. ## What **The broken page** - `astro.config.mjs`: `trailingSlash: 'ignore'`, so Astro matches the on-demand routes with and without the slash. The static output is identical: a diff of `dist/` before and after shows only the files listed below. - `src/lib/trailing-slash.ts` (new): `slashedLocation(url)` gives the canonical path and keeps the query string. `/aanbod/`, `/aanbod/[slug]` and `/aanbod/online-voorraad/[slug]` answer the slashless form with a 301 to it, the same thing Netlify does for the static pages. - The sitemap now answers on `/sitemap-index.xml` too, and `public/robots.txt` names that form. The comment in `netlify.toml` and the README say what changed. **LCP** - `public/theme/hero/gevel-mobiel-900.webp` (new, 900×1451, 116 kB), downscaled from the existing mobile crop. `src/lib/hero.ts` gives the mobile `` a `srcset` of 900w and 1100w with `sizes="(max-aspect-ratio: 1100/1774) 62vh, 100vw"`. On a phone the hero is 100vh tall and the image is `object-fit: cover`, so its height sets its width. The preload in `Layout.astro` carries the same `imagesrcset`/`imagesizes`, so it fetches the same file. A 3x phone still takes the 1100w file. - `public/assets/fonts/Inter-*.woff2` are subset to Latin with fonttools: Latin-1, Latin Extended-A, punctuation, €, sub- and superscripts (CO₂ appears on car pages), ✓, with the default layout features plus `tnum`, which `.sc-num` uses. Total size goes from 258 kB to 122 kB, and the preloaded ExtraBold from 67 kB to 32 kB. I checked every character in the built pages, the 37 live sitemap pages and `src/` against the subset, and none is missing. The exact command is in the `@font-face` comment in `stockcars-brand.css`. ## Checked - `npm test`: 7 files, 49 tests pass, including the new `test/trailing-slash.test.ts`. - `npm run build`: passes. `dist/` compared with the build of `main`: only the four fonts, `robots.txt`, the new 900w image, and the hero markup in `index.html` and `contact/index.html` differ. - Built SSR handler, called directly: `/aanbod` 301 to `/aanbod/`, `/aanbod?make=12&sort=year_desc` 301 to `/aanbod/?make=12&sort=year_desc`, `/aanbod/23924-nissan-micra` 301 to the slashed form, `/sitemap-index.xml` and `/sitemap-index.xml/` both 200 with the sitemap, an unknown path still 404. - `npm run check` (astro check): the same 19 errors as on `main`, none in a changed file. - Lighthouse 12, mobile, three runs each against the built site served locally (no compression, so the absolute numbers run high): the build of `main` measured LCP 4.8 / 4.8 / 4.7 s with score 75 to 76, and this branch measured LCP 3.7 / 3.7 / 3.7 s with score 84 to 85. The LCP element is unchanged (the hero image), now loading `gevel-mobiel-900.webp`. - A screenshot of the mobile home at 412 px and DPR 1.75 shows the hero and headings rendered in Inter. Not in this PR, and not fixable from this code: - `/aanbod/` and the home load the car photos from `traders.stocklistdealer.eu` at 854×638 (about 85 kB each) for 201×134 thumbnails. A smaller size has to come from the Stocklist image service. - The rest of the LCP is the Netlify response time and four render-blocking stylesheets. Lighthouse marks 92% of `foundation.css` as unused, but removing it means reworking the inherited theme.
params.title: Fix /aanbod 404 without slash, lighter mobile hero and fonts for LCP
